# ChipletRoutingFabric

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A structured network-on-chip (NoC) or inter-chiplet routing architecture that manages data flow between chiplets using specialized switches, buffers, and routing algorithms. Critical for minimizing latency and congestion in distributed training workloads, as it governs the effective bandwidth and fault tolerance of the interconnect.
